title: デイリー杯ジュニアSにむけて

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Welcome, Bright! I'm so glad you made it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hello. I'm looking forward to running with you, Pearl. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl's biggest opponent today is Mejiro Bright, a gentle Umamusume of the prestigious Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both her demeanor and growth as a racer are quite laid-back. Since junior-year mile races require precocity and great sprinting power, I wouldn't have guessed she'd be in today's race…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll be representing the Mejiro family today in this race against you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wow… You're standing in for your entire family, huh? I see. But…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Races aren't a family affair, Bright. They're lonesome and isolating things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: They are?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: They sure are. No one can help you when you're on the track. When you're out there, you're all alone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My dad was once the same.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: In search of gold, he forged ever westward. He overcame his loneliness and continued on his journey…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then he finally and literally struck gold. That's the spirit of those on the frontier.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I aim to follow in his footsteps by discovering new lands of my own—even if I can only do so once in my lifetime.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Being strong means carving your own path, not relying on a family behind you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Wow… that's so fascinating. You may be right about that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But I'm of the Mejiro family, so I've always thought of myself as a part of them. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: W-well, I suppose you're not wrong about that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bright's heart and mind don't seem particularly fired up about anything. I don't understand where she gets her enthusiasm to run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I heard she's not in top form yet either… Do I really need to be that careful of her?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's better safe than sorry.
Yeah, it's better safe than sorry.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: …You're pretty serious about this. Did you sense something in her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In fact, there is something that's bugging me. I heard the main cause for concern with Mejiro Bright is that her legs aren't fully developed yet…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when I saw her walking through the runners' tunnel just now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She didn't seem worried about her legs at all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is it just because she's so laid-back? Or is it something different entirely?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right. I'll keep an eye on her since you insist, but…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to lose to a family. This pearl is going to shine all by her lonesome today!
